verdict.rationale: Ramp documents "unlimited free same-day ACH and international wires for bill payments," which addresses international payments and wire fees, and end-to-end vendor bill payment. Its API monetary model uses ISO 4217 codes such as EUR and JPY, but it warns that "a currency's presence in a schema does not mean every payment method supports it," so paying vendors in their local currency is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation of local-currency vendor payouts, FX rate/markup disclosure for fee transparency, supported country/currency coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
